item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
### Fixed
- **App failed to launch on other Macs ("Launchd job spawn failed").** The release build re-signs the app after embedding Sparkle, and that step passed the raw entitlements file to `codesign`, which (unlike Xcode) doesn't expand `$(AppIdentifierPrefix)`. The shipped app ended up with a literal `$(AppIdentifierPrefix)com.qampo.HarvestPlus` keychain-access-group, which macOS (AMFI) rejects at launch — so 1.1.0 wouldn't open on any machine other than the build machine (whose running copy was an older build). The build script now resolves the prefix before re-signing, and verifies the embedded entitlements are fully expanded so this can't ship again. No app-code change.
